title: ReputablePseoCorpus
description: Schema for the calibration corpus used by scripts/calibration-corpus.ts

detectability.description: Whether the policy violation is visible in fetched page content. 'off-page-only' = site-reputation parasite / host-relationship abuse that an on-page audit cannot detect by construction. Absent = on-page-detectable. Used to compute the engine's addressable calibration ceiling separately from undetectable cases.

synthetic.description: true = hand-constructed fixture asserting a recall floor on a specific rule, not a real-world site. Excluded from real-world recall/precision metrics; kept as a separate must-catch floor.

pinnedUrls.description: v0.5.12 — pinned page URLs for stable calibration. When non-empty, the calibration runner passes these directly to auditSource as pinnedUrls, bypassing sitemap discovery and random sampling. Populated by --repin mode. Empty array means legacy random sampling.

localFixtureDir.description: v0.5.15 — relative path to the fixture directory containing pre-captured HTML for this site (e.g. 'packages/core/calibration/fixtures/wise_com/'). When set and the directory exists, the calibration runner audits from disk instead of making HTTP requests. Populated by --snapshot mode. Absent means live HTTP fetch.

classifierUrls.description: v0.6.1 — full sitemap URL list used for site classification and template detection. Allows fixture-mode calibration (25 pinned audit URLs) to still see the site's true scale and template shape. Populated by --seed-classifier-urls mode. Absent means the classifier uses the audit URL set (the old behaviour).
